parameter_revision.capacity_definition: sum over technology-compatible facilities / mean global generation per period
parameter_revision.capacity_allocation: equal effective capacity among technology-compatible facilities; no rounding
parameter_revision.risk_calibration: same arc, two equal positive loads; baseline transport plus additional coload risk; excludes inventory risk
parameter_revision.risk_generation: independent pair strengths Uniform(2,5); gamma=strength*(h_s+h_t)/2; no extremum calibration
parameter_revision.empirical_status: user-specified synthetic stress scenario, not a chemical safety calibration

reference_construction.method: all-period joint vehicle-facility assignment followed by alternating-producer routing
reference_construction.purpose: common reference only, no cost-risk optimization or benchmark warm start
